prompt: Match each design requirement to the Microsoft Responsible AI tenet it serves.

left.text: Users must understand what data the agent relies on and how decisions are made
People, not machines, remain responsible for AI outcomes through governance and oversight
The agent must work for people of all abilities without creating barriers
The system is validated regularly and designed to prevent unsafe outputs

explanation: Die sechs Tenets: Fairness, Reliability & Safety, Privacy & Security, Inclusiveness, Transparency, Accountability. Transparenz = verständliche Logik und Datennutzung; Accountability = menschliche Verantwortung und Oversight; Inclusiveness = barrierefrei; Reliability & Safety = validiert, überwacht, keine unsicheren Outputs.

source.title: Define core tenets of responsible AI guidelines for AI business solutions
source.quote: People—not machines—are responsible for AI outcomes.

prompt: A project plan lists fairness testing, security reviews, and transparency documentation. In which lifecycle stage does the learning content place these activities?

options.text: During development, together with the first evaluation runs
During design, where risks and expected users are defined
During deployment, alongside pre-production validation
During operations, as part of retraining and policy updates

explanation: Design: Risiken, Nutzer, Sicherheitsszenarien definieren. Development: Fairness-Tests, Security Reviews, Transparenz-Dokumentation. Deployment: Human Oversight, Pre-Production-Validierung, Monitoring. Operations: kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

source.title: Define core tenets of responsible AI guidelines for AI business solutions
source.quote: Apply fairness testing, security reviews, and transparency documentation

topic: Business terms for Copilot in Customer Service
prompt: Supervisors complain that Copilot case summaries in Dynamics 365 Customer Service use outdated category names and miss the organization's SLA tiers. Where does the learning content say business terms are primarily stored and read by Copilot?

options.text: In Dataverse fields, option sets, and classification metadata, which Copilot reads directly when generating summaries
In a separate prompt library in SharePoint that Copilot queries at runtime whenever a summary is generated for a case
In the Azure OpenAI deployment's system prompt, configured by the tenant admin for each Customer Service environment
In Teams channel descriptions and wiki pages, which Copilot indexes through Microsoft Graph and uses for summarization

explanation: Business Terms sind das standardisierte Vokabular der Organisation; in Dynamics 365 Customer Service liegen sie vor allem in Dataverse-Feldern, Option Sets und Klassifikationsmetadaten, die Copilot direkt für Zusammenfassungen und Empfehlungen liest.

source.title: Design business terms for Copilot in Dynamics 365 Customer Service
source.quote: In Dynamics 365 Customer Service, business terms are primarily stored in Dataverse fields, option sets, and classification metadata.

prompt: A regulated insurer needs every Copilot conversation summary in Customer Service to contain the same sections (customer issue, actions taken, pending items, next steps, resolution status) to reduce variability between agents. Which configuration does the learning content recommend?

options.text: Structured format, where admins select which fields and data points Copilot includes in predefined sections
Paragraph format, which produces a cohesive narrative and is intended for organizations with strict documentation standards
Disable conversation summaries for the regulated queues and rely on manual agent notes with a mandatory template
Map each legacy field to the summary so that Copilot has maximum context and can fill the sections consistently

explanation: Structured Format zerlegt die Zusammenfassung in vordefinierte Abschnitte, Admins wählen Felder, ideal für strenge Dokumentationsstandards und regulierte Branchen; Paragraph Format liefert einen Fließtext für schnelle Übersicht. Legacy-Felder, die den Prozess nicht mehr abbilden, sollen ausgeschlossen werden.

source.title: Design business terms for Copilot in Dynamics 365 Customer Service
source.quote: Ideal for organizations with strict documentation standards or regulated industries

prompt: Match each customization change for Copilot in Dynamics 365 apps to the customization area it belongs to.

Require an empathetic tone and a summary-plus-next-steps structure in drafts
Limit which case fields and knowledge sources Copilot can reference
Show Copilot output in case forms and agent dashboards

explanation: Vier Anpassungsbereiche: Business Terms (Vokabular), Prompt Settings (Ton, Struktur, Pflichtfelder, zu vermeidende Begriffe), Data Scope (Felder, Entitäten, Wissensquellen) und Surface Integration (Formulare, Timelines, Dashboards).

prompt: A service manager wants Copilot to reference every available CRM field "so it never misses anything". Which best practice from the learning content argues against this?

options.text: Limit data scope to necessary fields for better precision and reduced noise
Expand data scope continuously, because more referenced fields improve accuracy
Disable human oversight once the data scope has been completed and validated
Freeze prompts once they are approved so output stays stable as strategies evolve

explanation: Best Practices: mit Agenten-Workflows starten, Business Terms konsistent halten, Outputs regelmäßig prüfen, Datenumfang auf nötige Felder begrenzen, Prompts aktualisieren, menschliche Validierung sicherstellen.

source.title: Design customizations for Copilot in Dynamics 365 apps

topic: Custom connectors for Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales
prompt: A developer plans a custom connector so Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales can pull insights from a third-party pricing API. Evaluate each statement against the learning content.

statements.text: The connector must be created in an environment with Dynamics 365 apps enabled; the default environment is not supported.
Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with Microsoft Entra ID, and the connector and backend rely on two app registrations.
Once the Copilot action is published, it appears in the Sales experience immediately for all users.
Certification of the connector and plugin is mandatory before any user can access the action.

explanation: Pflicht: Umgebung mit Dynamics 365 (Default nicht unterstützt), OAuth 2.0 mit Entra ID und zwei App-Registrierungen, Action in Copilot Studio erstellen/publishen und vom Admin freischalten lassen. Actions können bis zu 7 Tage brauchen; Zertifizierung ist optional für organisationsweite Verfügbarkeit.

source.title: Design connectors for Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales

prompt: Sellers should not be prompted to sign in separately when a Copilot plugin calls the backend through the custom connector. Which setting does the learning content specify to enable automated authentication?

options.text: Set Enable onbehalfoflogin to true so the plugin uses on-behalf-of tokens
Use API-key authentication instead of OAuth 2.0 so no user token is needed
Register a single app registration shared by the connector and the backend
Create the connector in the default environment where single sign-on is automatic

explanation: Für automatisierte Authentifizierung mit OBO-Tokens bei Plugins ist Enable onbehalfoflogin = true zu setzen. Grundlage bleiben OAuth 2.0, Entra ID und zwei App-Registrierungen für den Token-Austausch.

source.title: Design connectors for Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales

prompt: A Dynamics 365 Contact Center team configures agent context for an AI agent on the live chat channel. The CRM has 300 customer attributes. What does the learning content recommend about which attributes to expose?

Expose the full set of 300 attributes so the agent can reason over the complete customer profile
Expose no attributes and let the agent ask the customer for each detail it needs
Expose attributes on the voice channel alone, because chat does not carry context

A goal for the record event and a knowledge source for the escalation rule
An action for the record event and a publishing step for the VIP escalation rule
A knowledge source for the record event and a goal for the escalation rule

source.title: Design autonomous agents in Copilot Studio

Publish the agent to Teams before testing the business logic
Start with the most complex use case to prove the value early

prompt: Match each conversational requirement to the Copilot Studio mechanism the learning content recommends.

Handle greeting, fallback, escalation, and disambiguation consistently
Branch the dialog differently for VIP versus standard customers
React when a Dataverse row is added, without a user prompt

explanation: Die Mechanismus-Tabelle: Generative Answers bei Fragen außerhalb der Topics, System Topics für Greeting/Fallback/Escalation/Errors/Disambiguation, Condition Nodes für Verzweigungen nach Variablen, Event Triggers für ereignisgetriebene, autonome Aktionen.

source.title: Design prompt-driven agents using Copilot Studio

prompt: A finance team wants a scheduled recurrence trigger that makes an agent send a daily summary without any user prompt. Which caveat from the learning content should the architect include in the design review?

options.text: Triggers must be explicitly authorized and may impact billing consumption
Triggers are unable to call connectors, so the summary has to be sent manually
Triggers are available in classic orchestration and not in generative mode
Triggers replace the system topics and disable the fallback topic

source.title: Design prompt-driven agents using Copilot Studio

Read and write records in Dynamics, SAP, or ServiceNow
Run a lightweight transformation or scoring step before returning results
Decompose a task into steps and choose the next safe action

right.text: Retrieval and grounding tools such as vector and hybrid search
Data and application connectors such as REST or Dynamics connectors
Compute tools such as Azure Functions and ML model tools
Reasoning tools such as planners and rule evaluators

source.title: Propose Foundry tools given a requirement

prompt: When proposing Foundry tools for a requirement, which selection goals does the learning content emphasize?

options.text: Meet the requirement with minimal complexity, ensure security and compliance, reuse enterprise systems, and support grounded outputs
Maximize the number of tools attached to the agent so that it can handle any future request without a redesign of the tool set or its instructions
Prefer custom-coded tools over native connectors to avoid vendor dependency, even where a connector already covers the system
Choose tools that bypass enterprise systems and query source databases directly, to reduce latency and integration overhead

explanation: Ziel der Tool-Auswahl: Anforderung mit minimaler Komplexität erfüllen, Sicherheit und Compliance sicherstellen, bestehende Unternehmenssysteme nutzen, Integrationsaufwand reduzieren, genaue, geerdete Outputs unterstützen.

source.title: Propose Foundry tools given a requirement

prompt: A sales operations team needs a customer overview page built rapidly, plus in-app next-best-action suggestions, and developers must add complex validation logic not expressible through prompts. Which combination does the learning content recommend?

options.text: Generative pages for rapid creation, an agent feed for insight-driven guidance, and code-first enhancements for the complex logic
Code-first development alone, because generative pages are not extensible and an agent feed is limited to canvas apps
Generative pages alone, because the generative engine also produces the validation logic and the next-best-action suggestions
An agent feed alone, which generates the page layout, the validation rules, and the in-app suggestions from the Dataverse schema and security roles

explanation: Generative Pages für schnelle datengetriebene Screens, Agent Feed für dynamische Insights und Next-Best-Actions, Code-first (JavaScript, PCF, Dataverse-Logik) zum Erweitern oder Überschreiben generierter UI; bei High-Volume-Automatisierung alle drei kombinieren.

source.title: Propose code first generative pages and agent feed applications

prompt: What does an agent feed add to a model-driven app according to the learning content?

options.text: An AI-powered layer that monitors app context and records and surfaces summaries, anomaly notifications, and next-best actions
A natural-language page designer that replaces the maker studio and generates layouts, bindings, and forms from a single prompt
A scheduled export of Dataverse records to Fabric that feeds a lakehouse for analytics and reporting on app usage
A PCF control library for custom layouts, event handlers, and security-aware data pipelines in model-driven apps

explanation: Der Agent Feed ist eine KI-Schicht in der App: Zusammenfassungen, Handlungsvorschläge („follow-up with this customer“), Anomalie-Benachrichtigungen, kontextuelle Insights, geführte Schritte und Automatisierungs-Trigger, basierend auf Kontext, Nutzeraktionen und Datensätzen.

source.title: Propose code first generative pages and agent feed applications
source.quote: The agent monitors app context, user actions, and records.

prompt: Analytics show 35 percent of conversations end in the fallback topic, which simply says "Sorry" and ends. Which two corrections does the learning content imply?

options.text: Make fallback acknowledge the misunderstanding, offer alternatives or a human handoff, capture feedback, and add topics
Remove the fallback topic entirely so that users have to rephrase until a topic matches, and log the failed attempts
Route each fallback to generative answers with general knowledge enabled, so that no conversation ends unanswered
Raise the trigger-phrase matching thresholds so fewer topics fire, which keeps the fallback cleaner and easier to analyze

explanation: Ein guter Fallback bestätigt das Missverständnis, bietet Alternativen, optional eine menschliche Übergabe und sammelt Feedback. Fallback darf starke Intent-Erkennung nicht ersetzen; die häufigsten Szenarien sollten Topics abdecken.

source.title: Design topics for Copilot Studio, including fallback

"Create support ticket" runs an automated step
"Business hours" provides structured information
Authentication logic shared across topics

source.title: Design topics for Copilot Studio, including fallback

prompt: An architect designs the ingestion-to-retrieval pipeline for a grounded AI solution on Azure AI Search. Evaluate each design decision against the learning content.

statements.text: Hybrid retrieval combining vector, keyword, and semantic reranking generally yields the most reliable results.
Marking every index field as searchable, filterable, sortable, and retrievable is recommended for flexibility.
Querying live systems on every conversational turn is preferred over an externalized search index.
A single index is the default; split indexes only when audiences, compliance boundaries, or query patterns differ.

explanation: Hybrid Search bevorzugt; Feld-Capabilities nur setzen, wenn genutzt (sonst Größe und Kosten); in einen Suchindex externalisieren statt Live-Abfragen je Turn; Single Index als Default, Split bei getrennten Zielgruppen/Compliance; Freshness SLO-basiert mit Side-by-Side-Rebuilds; Zitate für Provenance.

source.title: Design data processing workflows for grounded AI
source.quote: Mark fields as searchable, filterable, sortable, and retrievable only when you'll use them; extra capabilities increase size and cost.

prompt: A RAG solution returns incomplete answers and consumes many tokens per query. The documents were split into fixed 200-character chunks regardless of structure. Which guidance from the learning content addresses the root cause?

options.text: Choose chunk sizes that fit the model's context window and the documents' semantic boundaries
Increase top K from 5 to 50 so that more fragments reach the model in each prompt
Switch from hybrid retrieval to keyword search alone to reduce the number of tokens per query and per answer
Remove citations from the grounded prompt to shorten the output and save tokens

explanation: Chunking muss zum Kontextfenster und zu semantischen Grenzen passen; schlechtes Chunking erhöht Kosten und senkt Antwortqualität. Die Tabelle empfiehlt semantische Chunks in Modellkontextgröße und das Begrenzen von Top K und Token-Budgets.

source.title: Design data processing workflows for grounded AI
source.quote: Poor chunking increases cost and reduces answer quality.

A fine-tuned custom model in Microsoft Foundry

source.title: Design data processing workflows for grounded AI

prompt: Match each scenario to the language-understanding approach the learning content recommends in Copilot Studio.

left.text: A call-center bot must recognize fixed phrases like "Reset password" with deterministic routing for a regulated process
A field-service bot must understand dozens of ways to report the same problem and extract device type and location
A sales assistant summarizes CRM records, answers long-form questions from knowledge articles, and drafts emails

source.title: Determine the use of standard natural language processing

prompt: A maker wants to enable generative orchestration for every agent by default. Which best practice from the learning content should temper this?

Generative orchestration is cheaper than NLU because it needs no trained intents, so it should be the default for agents
Generative orchestration does not need grounding for enterprise answers, so it can be enabled before knowledge is added
Guardrails such as instructions and topic triggers become unnecessary once generative orchestration is enabled

Success criteria are technical thresholds owned by engineering, while adoption goals are financial targets owned by finance
Adoption goals are set by the platform vendor's adoption framework, while success criteria are defined by the AI Center of Excellence
They are synonyms used interchangeably in the Cloud Adoption Framework, both describing measurable business outcomes

explanation: Success Criteria = welche Outcomes (Business Value, Effizienz, UX, Qualität, Risiko, Skalierung); Adoption Goals = wie die Organisation sie annimmt und skaliert (organisatorische, Daten-, technische Readiness, Nutzeradoption).

source.title: Define success criteria and adoption goals for AI business solutions
source.quote: Adoption goals guide how the organization will embrace and scale those outcomes.
